purpose: Prepare and execute the finite physical application-impact gate independently of the S2 human gesture session. No API promotion or SDK source change.
source_limits: Baseline is release3.17.0 before the multi-scene prototype. Candidate is the full current prototype, not the selected S2 composition or an approved future S3 release. Any measured result binds to exact source bytes; future API/production changes require a scoped reuse decision. A regression does not by itself attribute cost to an individual component.

workloads.tracking: Ordinary automatic UIKit views/actions on both arms; one active scene in a multi-scene-capable application.
workloads.journey: Deterministic local list, animated scroll, animated push to detail, sheet present/dismiss, pop to same root. Twelve measured cycles, eight seconds per cycle; two unmeasured warmup cycles. No external request or generated native gesture.

workloads.tracking: Same customer-owned NavigationStack and sheet on both arms. Baseline existing trackRUMView modifiers; candidate existing experimental RUMNavigationHost observes one accepted-state publisher. No API addition or generated RUM start/stop shortcut.
workloads.journey: Same deterministic local list, animated scroll and accepted route/presentation sequence as UIKit. Native visible callbacks and actual route state verify completion. Ordinary programmatic navigation is the measured workload, not interactive-gesture acceptance.

measurement.environment: One connected, unlocked physical iPhone27+ with Developer Mode; Release arm64 on Xcode27.1. No simulator performance substitution.
measurement.primary: Physical display-driver Core Animation FPS estimate and global display hitches during the exact app PID/run Workload interval, with unchanged single internal display and owned foreground topology. Process-bound Hangs plus task CPU deltas and phys_footprint samples bind the app PID. Full raw trace and exports retained; no exact per-app rendered-frame or individual hitch-causality claim.
measurement.secondary: Delivered display-link timestamp gaps and main-queue heartbeat support diagnosis only; requested display interval is not measured rendered FPS.
validity: Exact clean install, source/helper/compiler/product/installed identities and unique run nonce before workload
Identical fixed work and completed real controller/view callbacks; SDK mapper activity required in both arms
Foreground active throughout, one owned scene/window, unchanged display geometry/refresh policy, low-power disabled and nominal thermal state
All twelve cycles complete before immutable deadline; metric samples cover the entire active and final idle windows
Required raw trace tables and complete process/time mapping. Missing, unsupported or unparseable data is INVALID, never zero
No dropped samples, restored run ID, non-finite metric, stale build or missing cleanup; separate scenario/evidence/cleanup verdicts

thresholds.frame_rate: Each B/A directional comparison loses no more than5% active-interval mean measured display-driver FPS estimate. Same physical internal display, effective refresh policy and fixed foreground workload required; not exact per-app rendered-frame counts.
thresholds.hitches: Candidate excess hitch time ratio <=1 percentage point in each directional pair, and no new >=250ms hitch.
thresholds.hangs: No candidate main-thread hang >=250ms. A baseline hang >=250ms invalidates this workload qualification rather than normalizing a bad baseline.
thresholds.cpu: Candidate active CPU-seconds / wall-seconds increase <=max(10% of baseline,0.02 CPU cores) in each directional pair.
thresholds.memory: Median final20s physical footprint increase <=max(10% of baseline,10MiB); least-squares final20s footprint slope <=0.1MiB/s with >=20 samples and gaps <=1.5s. Candidate repeat growth minus baseline repeat growth <=5MiB across the fixed ABBA wave.
thresholds.pairing: A1 versus B2 and A4 versus B3 must each pass. No averages hiding one failing pair, adaptive thresholds or automatic rerun.

build_contract.signing: Unsigned generic-device builds may prepare compiler/source proof; installation requires a fresh signed-product manifest and actual signing availability. No protected project/config edits.

attempt_policy.qualification: First planned UIKit baseline qualifies capture/export/runtime. Missing required table, native effect or ownership stops this automated path. No equivalent diagnostic series.

trace_contract: Required complete raw physical trace and six exported tables: process-info, os-signpost-interval, core-animation-fps-estimate, hitches-summary, hitches-render-interval, potential-hangs. Exact Workload warmup/active/idle messages bind run UUID and PID/process lifetime, with consistent native-to-trace clocks. FPS is display-level; retain all global hitches and never filter window-server renders by app PID. Require one unchanged physical internal display, native full-screen owned readiness before workload, complete FPS coverage, positive process proof, hang threshold exactly250ms, and no competing workload. Present empty hitch/hang tables differ from absent tables. First planned physical baseline qualifies actual exported formats and full capture; missing/ambiguous evidence is INVALID.
